in_sanskrit.name: Sonu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Gold, Radiant

This name is radiant and full of warmth, symbolizing the golden sun that shines down upon us. In Hinduism, Sonu is also considered a name of the Hindu god Krishna, who is known for his love, kindness and loyalty.
